about_the_game:
Be a Cat. Cause Chaos. Nap Later.

Step into the paws of a mischievous house cat in this cozy chaos simulator. Choose your favorite breed and explore fully interactive environments where everything can be knocked over.

Key Features:

  • Choose Your Cat: Tuxedo, Black Cat, British Shorthair, Orange Cat, Siamese — and more to come!

  • Pure Feline Freedom: Walk, run, jump, climb, and swipe with physics-based actions.

  • Whirlwind Spin: Unleash a powerful spin attack to knock over everything around you.

  • Permanent Upgrades: Enhance your Whirlwind Spin — grow bigger, spin longer, and recharge faster for maximum chaos.

  • Collect Toy Friends: Discover and collect dozens of adorable plush toy companions — carry on back as you explore.

  • Play with Interactive Objects: Play with toys, scratch pads, or curl up to sleep in a cozy box between bursts of chaos.

  • Variety of Environments: Cause chaos beyond the house — explore office, bookstore, and supermarket, each packed with unique toys and topple-able items.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: 2.5 GHz Dual Core
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1060 or Radeon RX 580
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: 3.0 GHz Quad Core
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1080 or Radeon RX 6600
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
